findings.note: Listed as one of six sponsors of HB 215, the Voter List Integrity Act. The bill bars state and local election officials from joining certain multistate voter-list groups, allows joint compacts between states for voter-list maintenance, and allows sharing of driver's license and ID card information for that purpose. Date is the introduction date shown on the page.
